title: Eclipse S-CORE - Communication: network (copying) gateway transport configuration schema
description: mw::com gateway network transport configuration, used by transport ids zenoh_pico and cyclone_dds

rpc.title: Request delivery
rpc.description: Ack, retry and dispatch settings shared by all network backends.

ack-timeout-ms.description: Wait for an ack before resending a request.

max-attempts.description: Sends of one request including the first.

dedupe-window.description: Recently dispatched request sequences remembered to drop resends.

connect.description: Endpoint to connect to, e.g. tcp/10.0.0.2:7447.

listen.description: Endpoint to listen on, e.g. tcp/0.0.0.0:7447.

local-key.description: Key expression of this gateway's inbox.

remote-key.description: Key expression of the peer gateway's inbox.

max-frame-size.description: Must not exceed Z_FRAG_MAX_SIZE of the zenoh-pico build.

remote-topic.description: Topic of the peer gateway's inbox.

config-xml.description: Cyclone DDS XML configuration. Empty: CYCLONEDDS_URI or defaults.
